analytics.name: Analytic 1790
analytics.guidance: For Android, detect Transmitted Data Manipulation by correlating analyst-visible device/network evidence and management state; use streaming or batched telemetry only where the documented collector is deployed. Correlate API Calls via Application Vetting / Instrumented Dynamic Analysis [Dynamic API/runtime trace: ClipboardManager.addOnPrimaryClipChangedListener() registered]; Application State via Android Enterprise / EMM [Managed package inventory/status and package metadata]; System Notifications via Android Enterprise / Managed App Telemetry [Documented DPC/admin callbacks or managed-app generated event telemetry]. Alert on a sequence or state change inconsistent with the device/app baseline, approved management policy, or expected user workflow; do not infer unobserved API calls, file/process activity, or payload content from management state alone.

tuning.description: Approved password managers, approved clipboard tools. Minimal.
Default 5s between original copy and replacement — clipper acts immediately.
